svg.text: Single-use Special Action events (17.33): cardboard counters, to match the reusable Special Action blocks.
The band is the Higher Echelon colour; the turn number goes top-left. Delete the notes when done; convert text to outlines.

g.text: Single use, units of this Higher Echelon only;
then to the Eliminated Box. Uses: 8.21-8.27.
